articles.summary: Winter reliability begins hundreds of feet below ground at the Energy Transfer Marcus Hook Terminal. We store propane in large underground caverns, among the largest fuel storage facilities on the East Coast.
articles.title: Propane: The Unsung Hero of Energy

articles.summary: According to the most recent data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics and the National Association of Women in Construction (NAWIC), women now comprise 11.3% to 11.5% of the total construction workforce in the U.S.
articles.title: Women In Construction Week

articles.summary: Ten years ago this month, something remarkable happened along the Delaware River in Marcus Hook, Pennsylvania. A large vessel docked at Energy Transfer’s Marcus Hook Industrial Complex, but instead of bringing crude oil to the former refinery site, it was preparing to export a new kind of American energy to the world.
articles.title: Celebrating a Decade Since the Historic Ethane Shipment from Marcus Hook
